## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `--exclude` flag doesn't read its default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`, which the project's CLI-flag rule requires for every new flag. This should be fixed. No other defects were found in the reviewed scope.

## Changes
This pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` option that skips files whose basename matches any of the given patterns while `collect` walks the source tree. It also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md` and adds parser, collection and end-to-end archive tests.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Take the --exclude default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — When CI sets `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`, `--exclude` ignores it because the default is the fixed `default=[]`. This breaks `.claude/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`: "Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable". — CI pipelines that set options through the environment can't exclude files, so the matching files still go into the archive. — Fix: Build the default from `os.environ.get("ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE")`, choosing and documenting how several patterns are separated, and add a test to `tests/test_main.py` next to `test_exclude_defaults_to_nothing`.
